evals.prompt: 帮我把这篇文章导入 LLM Wiki: https://zread.ai/Panniantong/Agent-Reach
evals.expected_output: Agent should navigate to the URL, extract content via browser_console, get project list from clip server, and POST /clip to import. Should check for ~/.llm-wiki-import.json config first.

evals.prompt: 把 ~/Downloads/meeting-notes.md 这个文件导入到我的知识库
evals.expected_output: Agent should read the local file, check config, get projects from API, and POST /clip with the file content. Should use current project if user doesn't specify.

evals.prompt: 我有多个知识库项目，帮我把这段内容导入到 Work Notes 项目：人工智能（AI）是计算机科学的一个分支，旨在创建能够执行通常需要人类智能的任务的系统。
evals.expected_output: Agent should get project list, find 'Work Notes' project path, and POST /clip with the content to that specific project. Should NOT hardcode any paths.
